advisory_en: KISHAN KUNJ: flood probability 84% — risk level HIGH. Flagged at this risk level since 05:30 IST. Highest probability so far at 09:30 IST. About 49,613 residents are in the exposed area, with 3 hospital(s), 5 school(s) and 44.3 km of road. Main drivers: near an underpass, rainfall today, near a bridge structure. No pumping assets are mapped in this ward.
